back_translation: I turned back and saw all the oppression that takes place under the sun. Behold, the tears of the oppressed — and they had no comforter; power was in the hand of their oppressors — and they had no comforter.
So I praised the dead who had already died, more than the living who are still alive.
But better than both is the one who has not yet been born, who has never seen the evil that is done under the sun.
I saw that all toil and all skill of work come from a man's envy of his neighbor. This too is without substance, a chasing after the wind.
The fool folds his hands and eats his own flesh.
One handful with tranquility is better than two handfuls with toil and chasing after the wind.
I turned back and saw something without substance under the sun:

There is a man all alone, with neither son nor brother. There is no end to his toil, and his eyes are not satisfied with wealth. “For whom do I toil and deprive my soul of good?” This too is without substance — a burdensome task.
Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their toil.
For if one falls, the other can lift his companion up. But woe to the one who falls with no second person to lift him up.
Likewise, if two lie down together they will be warm; but how can one alone be warm?
And though one may be overpowered, two can stand and resist. And a cord of three strands is not quickly broken.
A youth who is poor but wise is better than a king who is old but foolish, who no longer knows how to receive a warning.
For he came out of prison to become king, though he was born poor in his own kingdom.
I saw all the living who walk under the sun following the second youth, the one who rose up in the king's place.
There was no end to all the people who were before them, yet those who come later will not rejoice in him. This too is without substance, a chasing after the wind.
Guard your feet when you go to the house of God. To draw near to listen is better than to offer the sacrifice of fools, for they do not know that they are doing evil.
